desc: 小罐睡眠唇膜：白底主图、质地旋峰、双栏唇部对照与六罐阵列
name: 玫粉渐变罐装睡眠唇膜款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用干净罐身剪影与一抹质地交代膏体形态。
一秒传达核心利益，用刮棒挑起的膏体旋峰做主视觉主张。
shots.textZone: left third column, one headline slot over one subline slot

shots.intent: 放大起皮干渴的唇部状态，制造代入感并引出护理动作。
用同机位同光的六格唇部状态矩阵呈现差异，替代原始前后主张。
shots.textZone: two blank rounded pill frames at the lower left and lower right, no words rendered

shots.intent: 以手持实物的近人尺度场景建立代入，并把数据栏留成空位。

shots.intent: 展示真实上唇动作与膏体铺展方式，让用户预演使用步骤。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, comparison panels and spec screens; flat rose-pink field #F7C3C8 and pale petal panel #FAEFF0 for benefit, texture and variant screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line rings and pill frames in accent #E8465B, no filled pictograms, no badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: bright soft beauty lightbox lighting, front key with fill card, skimming or sweeping accent light only where texture must read, gentle contact shadows, never harsh, never flat flash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium soft-pink lip care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white background #FFFFFF, rose-pink field #F7C3C8, one berry-red accent #E8465B and charcoal text #38343A; bright soft beauty lightbox lighting with a front key, fill card and skimming or sweeping texture accent, always with soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one uppercase headline weight and one light subline weight; thin single-weight line rings and pill frames only, no filled pictograms and no badge artwork; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 product angle and scale; hands and lip crops never reveal identity; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no filled award badges or star ratings
style.presentationRules: the jar stays upright with the same straight-on or slight 3/4 read across screens; the texture sweep always arcs away from the label face and never covers it; hands and lips stay cropped so no identity reads
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale laminate #EFEDEE, warm grey backdrop #E9E4E2 and glossy petal acrylic sheet #FAEFF0
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one uppercase headline weight plus one light subline weight, all rendered copy reduced to placeholder slots
